body:

QA-source: #21056 · access-security.rls-both-sides · acceptance[5]

## What is known publicly

- The showcase reference app declares owner isolation in its contributor permission set ("Contributors only see invoices they own"). For one of the ways a member can come to hold that set, the isolation is not applied, and the member can read and write other members' records.
- The platform enforces the policy exactly as the spec documents it; the defect is in how the showcase authors the set — **showcase authoring, not platform semantics**.
- The checklist's standing probe for this clause (`access-security.rls-both-sides`, acceptance[5]) is red on this run.

**Detail withheld pending maintainer** (RUNNER rule 2). Maintainer ruling on this card, verbatim (in Claude Code session `session_01MRdbfpy4sQT8bUjmMhxsN7`, 2026-10-01):

> 只发脱敏版

## Landing site

`examples/app-showcase/src/security/permission-sets.ts`, plus the showcase's invoice isolation dogfood pin (it does not exercise the shipped set). The maintainer holds the reproduction and the mechanism.
